items.subject: Routed miles are preliminary NHDPlus V2
items.explanation: Except for the six NPS Grand Teton/Flagg sections, miles are NLDI (NHDPlus V2) chainage between agency points. Off-line points (>300 m from the V2 line) give rougher miles.
items.nextAction: Replace with agency mileage where a WGFD/BLM/USFS float guide publishes it.

items.subject: NHD HR substitution
items.explanation: The NHDPlus HR MapServer was unavailable, so the 150 m rule used USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages downloaded from the National Map (sha256 in research/sources.json); GeoPackages are not bundled.
items.nextAction: None required; re-run tools/wy_geo_checks.py if the service returns.
